findings.name: verifiable
findings.resolution: Removed the external LLM judge and replaced it with deterministic Playwright checks.

findings.name: difficult
findings.resolution: State-machine difficulty is documented, but Connect Four is intentionally a smaller task and cannot honestly be described as multi-year expert work.

findings.name: anti_cheat_robustness
findings.resolution: Verifier runs in a separate image; submitted code starts as UID 10001 and cannot write verifier tests or logs.

findings.name: deterministic_reproducible
findings.resolution: No live judge API remains; all checks use fixed browser actions and exact state assertions.

findings.name: test_instruction_alignment
findings.resolution: Removed the 489-line browser rubric and aligned each deterministic check to the product brief.

findings.name: novel
findings.resolution: The game is intentionally familiar; novelty would require replacing the task concept, not editing the verifier.

findings.name: difficulty_explanation_quality
findings.resolution: Added practitioner, state-machine, generated-state, and implementation-risk context.

findings.name: verification_explanation_quality
findings.resolution: Added verification_explanation metadata with isolation, evidence, and reward policy.

findings.name: environment_hygiene
findings.resolution: Removed Python, Playwright, Chromium, fonts, and other verifier-only packages from the agent image; browser tooling remains only in tests/Dockerfile.

findings.name: category_and_tags
findings.resolution: Set category to Software, subcategory to Classic & Board Games from the supplied taxonomy, and added focused metadata tags.

findings.name: task_toml_schema
findings.resolution: Removed the flagged invented metadata and phase overrides and declared restricted networking with allow_internet = false; Harbor 0.21.0 validates and normalizes the current task config.

findings.name: structured_data_schema
findings.resolution: Removed the private localStorage key/schema prescription from the brief and the matching field-name assertions from the verifier. Persistence remains verified through exact visible board, turn, history, Undo/Redo, and score state after reload.

findings.name: verifier_execution_isolation
findings.resolution: Added tests/Dockerfile and environment_mode = separate; Oracle exercised this path successfully.

findings.name: ctrf_reporting
findings.resolution: Verifier always emits /logs/verifier/ctrf.json, including startup failure fallback.

findings.name: binary_reward
findings.resolution: reward is exactly 1.0 only when preflight and all 13 checks pass; otherwise it is 0.0.
